12/08/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat auction Thursday evening with a light but good quality offering of hair lambs and kid goats.  Slaughter lambs weighing 50-70 lbs sold 10.00-25.00 higher than last month with lambs over 70 lbs selling with a higher undertone.  Kid goats traded with a firm to higher undertone compared to last months light offering.  Montgomery County holds their Sheep and Goat sale the 2nd Thursday of each month.
11/10/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening with a light offering of sheep and goats but a nice overall quality offering.  Slaughter lambs on a light test sold 10.00-30.00 higher, spots 40.00 higher than last months auction weighing mostly 50-80 lbs, over 80 lbs sold mostly 5.00 higher with Kid goats trading with a higher undertone on a light test.  There was two consignments of replacement ewes from young ewes to solid mouth ewes that sold with moderate to good demand.  Montgomery County Livestock holds their Sheep and goat sale the seconf Thursday of each month.
10/13/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening with mostly hair slaughter lambs selling 10.00-20.00 lower than last month with a light test of kid goats trading with a lower undertone.  Demand was moderate to good on a light to moderate supply.
09/08/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and goat sale Thursday evening with the best test on slaughter lambs weighing 60-75 lbs selling mostly 20.00-40.00 higher, spots 50.00 higher than last month with several very good consignments of good to top quality ewe lambs weighing mostly 60-80 lbs going back to the farm as replacements sold with good demand on and active market.  Kid goats were lightly tested.
08/11/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening with nice offering of slaughter lambs weighing 55-90 lb mostly hair lambs and selling 15.00-30.00 higher than last month with spots 40.00 higher on the 60-70 lb lambs.  Kid goats sold with a higher undertone on a light test.
07/14/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening with slaughter lambs selling mostly 60.00-90.00 lower than last months auction.  There were several lots and groups of good quality ewe lambs in the offering going back as replacements along with several groups of lambs weighing 50-78 lbs going back as feeders, as the market has moved sharply lower over the last two months.  Kid goats were not well tested but sold with a lower undertone.
05/12/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat auction Thursday evening with two large consignments of bred ewes mostly hair cross ewes 3 to 6 years of age  selling with moderate to good demand,  Slaughter lambs sold steady to firm with last months offering with market kid goats scarce.
04/14/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly sheep and goat sale Thursday evening April 14, with the offering  mostly hair lambs weighing 40-70 lbs selling mostly 30.00-50.00 lower than last months sale, with kid goats on a light offering not well tested.
03/10/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening March 10, with a light offering of slaughter lambs on a snowy evening.  There was a nice offering of feeder lambs that sold with good demand as the light offering of slaughter lambs were lightly tested.  Montgomery County holds their sheep and goat sale the second Thursday of each month.
02/10/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening with a light test of slaughter lambs weighing 50-60 lbs selling mostly steady with last month, 60-70 lbs sold steady to 5.00 lower on a light test and lambs over 70 lbs sold with a lower undertone on a much lighter supply than last month, with overall quality not as attractive as last months.  Kid goats were not well tested on a light offering.  Supply was light to moderate with demand moderate to good.
01/13/2022: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening with a supply consisting mostly of slaughter lambs weighing 40-100 lbs trading 50.00-75.00 higher than last months auction.  Demand was very good with supply light to moderate with lambs selling on a very active market.  Kid goats and nannies were scarce.  Montgomery County holds their sheep and goat sale the 2nd Thursday of each month.
